rules.statement: The obligation is a calendar year; an unwithdrawn measure and compost supplement renew automatically, but the measure contract ends if minimum participation is not met.

result.description: Valid 1 January through 31 December and automatic renewal.

rules.statement: At least 2.00 RGVE across all requested cattle categories is required as an annual average.

conditions.description: Aggregate annual average, not each category.

rules.statement: Only male cattle under 0.5 year, male cattle at least 0.5 year, female cattle under 0.5 year, and female cattle 0.5 to under 2 years are selectable categories.

conditions.description: Requested category is one of the four published categories.

rules.statement: A farm delivering milk to dairies, including seasonally on an alp, cannot participate with female cattle aged 0.5 to under 2 years.

result.description: The female older category is excluded.

rules.statement: Where more than 10.00 RGVE of eligible cattle are kept, participation in an approved cattle health service is required for the full funding year; evidence is supplied on request if not transmitted by the service.

result.description: Recognised cattle health service participation is mandatory.

rules.statement: Enrollment of female cattle requires full-year participation in Qplus Rind or a comparable female beef-cattle programme and evidence on request.

result.description: Qplus Rind or equivalent must be in force.

rules.statement: Participating cattle are group-housed on littered systems with a closed lying surface; up to 5 percent perforation counts as closed, litter covers at least 40 percent of required usable total area, and the lying area is soft and dry.

conditions.expression: animal.group_housed and perforation <= 5 and littered_area >= 0.40 * required_total_area

rules.statement: Required usable total area per animal is 1.80, 2.50, 3.00, 3.60, and 4.20 m² for weights up to 150, 220, 350, 500, and above 500 kg respectively; published lying-area values are 0.72, 1.00, 1.20, 1.44, and 1.68 m².

conditions.expression: available_total_area_m2 >= published threshold by live weight
conditions.description: Use the complete published weight table.

result.description: Required total stall-compartment area is available.

rules.statement: In mixed groups, the published space requirements apply to every animal; cows require 2.4 m² lying area and 6.00 m² total area, while only young cattle receive the premium.

conditions.expression: group contains eligible and ineligible cattle

rules.statement: Stall sketch and maximum-occupancy plan were required through application year 2024; from application year 2025 neither must be created.

result.description: Sketch and occupancy plan are required only through 2024.

rules.statement: Sick or injured cattle may be individually kept on litter for at most 10 days with documented reason and duration; calves under 21 days may be individually housed on litter with adequate social contact.

conditions.expression: individual housing due to illness/injury <= 10 days OR calf age < 21 days with social contact

result.description: Individual housing does not remove eligibility.

rules.statement: The compost supplement requires all farmyard manure from every animal species to be composted on-farm, normally with at least two compost-turner turns at least 14 days apart, or from 2025 an eligible layered/mixed manure-and-organic-material heap; establishment, turns, use or transfer are documented and compost barns are excluded.

result.description: 21.60 EUR/RGVE supplement can be paid from 2024.

rules.statement: If requirements cannot be met for one or more animals, immediately deregister the animal by ear tag online; a deregistered animal is not premium-eligible for this measure in that funding year, while sale/slaughter database departures need no separate notice and are pro-rated.

result.description: No premium for a measure-deregistered animal.

rules.statement: Combination with Tierwohl-Weide is animal-specific; pasture/alp time fulfils stall conditions but a qualifying home-farm stall remains necessary, and the premium is reduced to avoid overlap.

conditions.expression: animal participates in pasture, alp payment, or coupled alp support

rules.statement: Categories and supplement are requested before contract start by 31 December; last category entry is 2027 (apply by 31 December 2026), supplement entry is 2028 (apply by 31 December 2027), and a category contract lapses if no premium-eligible animal participates in a funding year.

result.description: Late or lapsed category needs a new timely measure application.

rules.statement: Eligible average RGVE from the cattle database are paid at 194.40 EUR/RGVE from 2024, 162.00 EUR/RGVE where named overlapping animal-linked payments apply, plus 21.60 EUR/RGVE for the eligible compost supplement; age entry is pro-rated.

conditions.expression: measure eligibility and eligible annual-average RGVE

result.description: Multiply RGVE by the applicable published rate.

rules.statement: Funded animals must be kept in Austria; non-compliance can be sanctioned by warning or percentage reductions through exclusion and recovery after two 100-percent reductions in the contractual period.

conditions.expression: animal kept in Austria and general obligations fulfilled

result.description: Animals outside Austria are not considered; serious repeated breaches may cause exclusion.
